skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — generate 5 attention-grabbing opening hooks for my fitness tutorial video...

latestVersion.changelog:
Free Video Hook Generator v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly generate 5 attention-grabbing video hooks with just a prompt and upload.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB.
- No editing experience required; ideal for TikTok, YouTube, and marketers.
- Simple cloud workflow: upload video, describe your hook, download results in ~20–40 seconds.
- Built-in credits system with free trial and clear status updates.
- Includes robust error handling and support for multiple export and edit workflows.
